text:
gina (Design): Quick thread about a small UI change: adding a mini-toolbar in the trace header for quick actions (Copy ID, Open spans, Export). Sketch: https://figma.redwood/trace-mini-toolbar. Main goals: make actions discoverable on narrow screens and fix export header confusion.

oliver (Product): Love quick actions. Customers want copy+search as one click. Also the CSV headers mismatch is causing parsing errors.

sasha (Eng-runtime): Implementation note: avoid adding extra heavy DOM for each trace. The toolbar lives in the header; minimap remains single-focus hotspot to save tab stops. We'll expose `aria-haspopup` on the export dropdown.

mona (Accessibility): For keyboard/screen reader users: toolbar buttons must be tabbable in a logical order. "Copy ID" needs an aria-label that includes the id (e.g., `aria-label="Copy correlation id 0xabc123"`). For the minimap, prefer one focusable element + arrow-key navigation and an aria-live update like: "Focused span 3 of 21: cache.get, duration 14ms, correlation id 0xabc123".

gina (Design): Copy changes: label the toolbar button "Copy & search" instead of two separate tiny icons. Export text: "Export events (CSV)" and "Export trace (JSON)"; snapshot: "Save trace snapshot (PNG)".

reza (Eng-SRE): Exports must include `correlation_id` and `span_id` fields. Also a structured CSV option (frame_0_fn, frame_0_file...) would help our incident tooling. Add a small note in the modal that shows machine keys vs UI labels.

sasha (Eng-runtime): We'll send export rows with machine keys (snake_case) and include a `columns` payload with {displayName, exportKey} so UI can render the mapping. Persist last-used format per workspace.

mona (Accessibility): The mapping table in the modal must be announced properly. Use semantic table markup or render as an accessible list. Dropdown must trap focus and support arrow keys.

gina (Design): Visual nit: the toolbar icons currently use #5f5f5f which fails WCAG AA on white. Suggest #2f2f2f. In compact mode make Copy visible text instead of icon-only.

oliver (Product): Add analytics: quickaction.copy_search, export.format_selected, minimap.keyboard_nav. Product wants to measure if people use the toolbar more than the old overflow menu.

sasha (Eng-runtime): Perf notes: precompute minimap geometry on mount; arrow-key movement updates a selectedIndex and moves a single highlight element. For dense stacks, use virtualization and lazy expand for collapsed vendor frames.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: trace-ui/header-toolbar v0.5 -> staging at 2026-04-07T18:00:00Z :rocket:

gina (Design): I'll update Figma and add a short PR checklist: 1) keyboard order + aria labels, 2) export column mapping modal + persisted format, 3) contrast token updated, 4) single-focus minimap + aria-live announcements, 5) analytics events. Tagging @mona and @reza for sign-off.
